set.title: Implement Beskar CLI per docs/BRIEF.md
set.body:
Implement the Beskar agent-skill manager described in docs/BRIEF.md as a Rust crate.

Constraints from the user:
- Language: Rust, zero external dependencies (std only).
- Hand-rolled CLI parsing (no clap).
- Custom configuration format ("bsk"): brace-based, keyword-led entries, line-oriented, comments preserved — unambiguous to parse, friendly to edit for humans and LLM agents.

text:
Implemented beskar 0.1.0 in crates/beskar (std-only, zero external deps, edition 2021).

- bsk config format (hand-written parser+writer): keyword-led line entries, brace blocks, quote-only-when-needed, comments and blank lines preserved byte-exact across edit round trips. One parser serves config.bsk, profiles/*.bsk, registry.bsk.
- Command families per BRIEF: init, doctor, library (init/add/scan/list/show/remove), profile (create/delete/list/show/add/remove), repo (add/remove/list/status/enable/disable/toggle/update), registry (list/status/stats/update/prune), plus update/status aliases.
- Reconciliation: pure plan(desired, installed, workspace) returning actions; separate Applier does fs + registry records. Drift matrix (clean / library changed / local drift / both changed) via SHA-256 directory manifests; adopt-if-identical for untracked dirs; remove-drift is a conflict, never a silent delete.
- Conflict policies ask/skip/replace/promote/abort; non-interactive default is keep-local + announce + exit 1. Interactive menu offers keep/library/promote/diff/abort.
- In-tree SHA-256 with NIST vectors; ISO-8601 timestamps without chrono; atomic writes; hand-rolled CLI parser with global flags anywhere; NO_COLOR/tty color detection.
- 60 unit tests + 2 integration tests (real binary, sandbox BESKAR_HOME) all green; zero build warnings.
- Docs: README.md and docs/bsk-format.md.

Not committed: awaiting user request.

reason: Done: brief implemented as std-only Rust crate at crates/beskar; 62 tests green; docs written.
